Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to make a traditional meat‑based lasagna (you can adjust or omit items to suit dietary preferences): | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Pasta** | • 12–15 sheets of lasagna noodles (regular or no‑boil) | | **Meat Sauce** | • 1 lb ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork)
• 1 small onion, finely chopped
• 2–3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or whole‑tomato sauce
• 1 can (6 oz) tomato paste
• 1 cup beef or vegetable broth (optional, for extra moisture)
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• ½ tsp dried thyme
• Salt & pepper to taste | | **Ricotta Layer** | • 15 oz ricotta cheese
• 1 egg (helps bind)
• ¼ cup grated Parmesan
• Pinch of nutmeg (optional)
• Salt & pepper | | **Mozzarella Layer** | • 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (part‑moist or part‑shelf) | | **Parmesan** | • ½–¾ cup grated Parmesan (for topping) | | **Optional Extras** | • 1 cup fresh spinach or chopped kale (folded into ricotta)
• ½ cup sliced mushrooms (added to the meat sauce)
• 1 tbsp fresh parsley or basil, chopped (for garnish) | ### Quick Prep Tips 1. **Cook the noodles** according to package instructions (or use no‑boil sheets). Drain and set aside. 2. **Brown the meat** with onions and garlic; add tomatoes, broth, and herbs; simmer 20–30 min. 3. **Mix ricotta** with egg, Parmesan, salt, pepper, and optional spinach. 4. **Layer**: Start with a thin layer of sauce, then noodles, ricotta, mozzarella, repeat, finishing with sauce + mozzarella + Parmesan on top. 5. **Bake** at 375 °F (190 °C) for 35–45 min, covered with foil for the first 30 min, then uncovered for the last 10–15 min to brown the top. Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
